description: Search active political prediction markets by topic or keyword. Returns matching markets with tickers, titles, and volume. Use this tool first when you need to find a market on a topic — then pass the ticker to get_market for live price data.

limit.description: Maximum results to return. Default 10, max 50

query.description: Topic or keyword to search for. Examples: "senate 2026", "federal reserve", "trump tariffs"

name: search_markets
